item.title: How waistlines, organ function tell a better story of obesity than BMI does
item.description: In 2025, The Lancet Diabetes & Endocrinology established a commission of 58 experts from different countries to set obesity-related guidelines. A new study in Nature has tested whether the commission’s recommendations can actually distinguish between people at different levels of risk, with data from 8.4 lakh adults
